string-array.name: about_changelog_v0181
string-array.item: Separated the low- and high-frequency Trigger paths while retaining assisted period estimation and global phase prediction for low fundamentals
Restored CorrScope-style waveform correlation matching at higher frequencies for improved stability with harmonic-rich signals
Fixed high fundamentals being mistaken for low subharmonics and delayed release of low-frequency assistance after a frequency increase

string-array.name: about_changelog_v0180
string-array.item: Added multi-stage cascades for low-pass and high-pass filters, with an independently adjustable cutoff for each stage
Changed the high-pass cutoff range to 20–10000 Hz and the default cutoff to 20 Hz
Improved low-fundamental Trigger stability with low-frequency-assisted period estimation and global phase prediction for weak-fundamental and strong-harmonic signals
Simplified Trigger settings by removing source mode selection and signal conditioning options
